instances.name: Account Servicing
instances.description: Open, maintain, block and close customer current accounts and manage their terms.

instances.name: Position and Balance Management
instances.description: Record every financial movement on an account and maintain the resulting balances and positions.

instances.name: Payment Execution
instances.description: Execute authorised payments through clearing schemes and track their outcome.

instances.name: Customer Reference Data
instances.description: Hold the master record of each customer and counterparty: identity, addresses, contact details, KYC status.

instances.name: Consumer Lending
instances.description: Originate, service and collect consumer loans.

instances.name: Treasury Management
instances.description: Manage the bank's liquidity, funding and market risk positions.
